title: `regex: false` — programs without regular expressions
preamble:
# `regex: false` — programs without regular expressions

The `regex: false` capability setting.
Prefix `LNRE`.

This document is an **overlay** on the base language and runtime specs.
It does not modify any base spec paragraph; it states how those paragraphs
are interpreted or restricted when `regex: false` is active.  Each overlay
section names the base paragraph it constrains. In particular, `regex: false`
introduces no mechanism of its own: it reaches the `regex` dialect form's
existing compile error and the reference engine's existing regex-less
build ([LFCA]) at file granularity.
